description: Tronçons routiers principaux du département du Rhône is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Road sections from the BdTopo 2012. Selection made on the types highway, quasi-highway, road to a pavement, ramp. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Main road sections of the Rhône department" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RHONE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
